messages:
sam: CI microbench failed on PR #20555 — kv_bench_small throughput -8%. Not noisy: CI diff crosses our threshold.
perf-bot: automated report attached.
perf-bot: THRESHOLD_DIFF DETECTED: kv_bench_small throughput -8.1% (p=0.003)
perf-bot: commits in range: a4c3b7f..d21e0c9 (merge window)
perf-bot: quick summary:
```
metric                baseline   current   delta
kv_bench_small_ops/s    1250      1149    -8.1%
kv_hit_rate              0.72      0.64    -11.1%
latency_p95_ms          12.3      14.8    +20%
```
sam: @jordan can you triage? this smells like kernel selector change from the merge earlier.
jordan: looking — I ran a quick flamegraph on the CI artifact. Kernel selection time is fine, but chosen kernel path changed: small-batch quant path used dense-kernel-2 instead of micro-kernel-1 for ~30% of sequences.
jordan: snippet from perf flame: `selector_score(micro-kernel-1)=0.47, dense-kernel-2=0.58` even when seq_len <= 32 and batch_size <= 4.
jordan: hypothesis: sampling weights recently adjusted to favor throughput for medium sequences; edge case affecting tiny batches and KV cache behavior.
lee: I can run a bisect across the merge range. starting with a4c3b7f -> d21e0c9. ETA ~20m.
perf-bot: bisect job queued (#bisect-739). will post results when done.
blake: can we hold the merge queue? this PR is blocking the release gate if it reproduces on staging. suggestion: mark rollout-blocker until we confirm root. :no_entry_sign: 
maria: +1 on hold. failing microbench is representative of a high-QPS small request workload.
perf-bot: bisect finished. culprit: 0f9e5b2 "kernel-selector: adjust score for kernel-reuse heuristic" — introduced weight change to reuse_score +0.2.
jordan: confirmed locally by reverting 0f9e5b2 -> kv_hit_rate returns to 0.71 and throughput recovers to baseline within noise.
sam: good repro. decide: revert 0f9e5b2 in main, open follow-up to make reuse_score adaptive instead of static bump.
blake: creating revert PR now: #20578. linking to this thread.
lee: I'll run an extended regression suite on the revert branch and on a patched branch that clamps reuse_score for small-batches.
jordan: quick patch idea: apply a size-aware factor: if batch_size <= 4 and seq_len <= 32 then reuse_score *= 0.6. that should avoid overshooting small-batch choices.
maria: after revert+patch we should run the KV warmup profile on canary to validate hit-rate and tail latency. schedule traffic shaping to mimic prod small-request distribution.
sam: thanks team. marking as resolved for now once revert lands and CI passes. follow-up: create an ev-pr with adaptive heuristic tests (unit + microbench).
perf-bot: revert PR #20578 opened and CI started.
sam: update: revert merged into main at 6400001200. will monitor canary.
lee: extended regressions running; initial canary looks good — kv_hit_rate back to ~0.70, p95 reduced.
jordan: will draft adaptive heuristic change and include a microbench that covers tiny-batch path to prevent regression.
sam: great. leaving this thread open until canary completes (ETA +1h).
